_about: The story's opening, a beat at a time (scripts/story.gd runs it on a new game). Each beat: id, objective (the card's title), hint (how to do it), start (what happens as it begins), done (what ends it), after (what happens as it ends). start/after actions: {do: spawn, what: slime|boar|mutatedVillager, count, near (units from Sera)}, {do: give, what, n}, {do: time, hour}, {do: clock, run: true|false}, {do: wake}, {do: messenger}, {do: mist_in}, {do: attack, count}, {do: ward}, {do: record, event}, {do: say, text}. done kinds: walked (units), killed (what, count: since the beat began), opened (character|talents), have (what: {resource: n} in her bag), built (what: [props], in_village), cooked (count of dishes cooked, since the beat began), slept, scene (id), reach_village, raid_over, stored (what: {resource: n} more in storage), houses (min condition), stored_dishes (count), morning.

beats.hint: W A S D to walk · Shift to run · Space to jump
Something's come out of the mist. Left click to strike.
More slimes along the road. Left click to strike; keep moving.
I (or C) opens your bag and your character.
P opens your talents. Spend a point when you have one.
E by a tree to chop it, by a rock to mine it. 10 wood and 5 stone.
A boar in the trees, and slimes. Boar meat can be cooked.
Night's coming. B to build: a Bonfire and a Leaf Bed.
At the lit bonfire, hold E with raw meat in your bag.
F to eat. Z by your bed to sleep: rest keeps you going.
Up the road north, then east to the houses. Hurry.
They're everywhere. Protect who you can.
The mist's in the village. B: place a Cleansing Crystal among the houses.
The elder is with them. E to talk.
Walls are down all over. Put 45 wood and 15 stone in a chest: the villagers will rebuild and mend with it.
The villagers are rebuilding the walls and mending the houses. Lend a hand gathering if they run short.
There's a bed for you in the village tonight. Z to sleep.

after.text: Morning. The elder looks like he hasn't slept.
